translations: so that you may receive mercy
puzzle.hint: This verse commands believers to listen attentively and with full focus when the Quran is being recited, promising divine mercy in return.
puzzle.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَأَنصِتُوا۟ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: So when the Qur’ān is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.
